title: Testing demand before buying inventory
description: A storefront that tested whether people would buy before the founders spent on inventory.
seoDescription: How a beauty brand tested purchase intent at checkout before investing in inventory, fulfillment, and a full e-commerce build.
constraints: Needed to test real purchase intent without taking payments or buying stock first.
problem: The founders had beauty product ideas and wanted to know whether people would buy before they spent money making products and holding inventory.
solution: Built a storefront that asks for an email instead of payment, so the founders could count buying attempts per product without shipping anything.
result: Visitors clicked a buy button 38 times and left 3 email signups, two for the shower oil and one for the bar soap. All three signups came in September 2025 through Instagram and Facebook.
